rca_of_the_issue: RCA — /api/aurem-dev/admin/insights/activation-funnel HTTP 499: HTTP 499 is nginx's 'Client Closed Request' — the upstream backend did not respond before the frontend's AbortController fired (or the user navigated away). Because the failure reproduces in <2s on every fresh /admin load and the rest of the admin overview renders fine, the most likely cause is (a) a heavy un-indexed Mongo aggregation in the activation-funnel handler that exceeds the frontend's fetch timeout, or (b) a missing await / hung dependency in the route. Mitigation: (1) add a 3-5s server-side timeout that returns a partial result, (2) cache the funnel daily and serve from a small collection, (3) ensure indexes exist on whatever date / user-state field the aggregation pivots on. The route file is `backend/routers/admin.py` (or wherever insights/activation-funnel is mounted) — start there.
